title: Unboxing Box Spreads: A Different Way to Think About Borrowing and Lending
summary: he name “box spread” might sound like options jargon wrapped inside more options jargon. But in a recent IBKR webinar, Rick Rosenthal, Director of North American Derivative Sales at Cboe Global Markets, did an excellent job of making the strategy much easier to understand. His presentation, Unboxing SPX Box Spreads: How to Borrow and Lend through Options Markets, broke the structure into manageable pieces without losing sight of the practical considerations.
